foundationGates.requirement: CI-001 is a transitive foundation: canonical repository/source connection identity, exact snapshot digest including commit, dirty bytes, included paths and policy hash, and local content receipts. These must exist before freshness or artifact-key code is connected.

foundationGates.requirement: CI-002 is a transitive foundation: reuse the same authorizeRepositoryRead/Write/Job resolver for content and manifest queries. A freshness status, visible manifest or cached artifact is not a content permission. Remote-private offline reads default deny; leases expire fail closed; reconnect invalidates authorization.
foundationGates.missingPrerequisite: Actor/workspace/source policy and lease resolver receipts, reconnect invalidation integration, and canonical path/symlink/exclusion policy. No new ACL cache or authorization store may be substituted.

risks: Git metadata is excluded by the current watcher, so commit-only changes are invisible without a dedicated bounded invalidation input in the same lifecycle.

Native index result comments describe mtime-based incremental unchanged detection, while TS index hashes truncated decoded text. Neither is sufficient for exact-source freshness; use accepted full-byte snapshot receipts.
Whole-file and root deletion removes FTS rows or drops watcher setup, but historical evidence must remain missing rather than disappear; truncated/unreadable coverage must not falsely imply deletion.
Timers can overlap async flushes and close cannot currently fence late publication. Artifact application additionally needs durable commit-time fencing and CAS, not just debounce serialization.
Alias display slugs currently prefix index paths. Canonical source connection/repository identities must reconcile deduplication without omitting required identity components.
Canonical root overlap includes nested and symlink-equivalent OpenWiki/Groma roots; accidentally reusing authored Notes as output would violate staged ownership.
Ownership/registry work overlaps CI-004. A second SQLite store, independent lock map or parallel ACL/freshness cache would split authority and fail restart/race guarantees.
CI-008 owns no RPC/bootstrap/channel/UI files. Implementing only its four modules without root consumer wiring would be disconnected and cannot satisfy full DoD.
All runtime, negative-control, persistence/recovery and UI proof is still unverified. Preflight validity is not feature completion or accepted dependency evidence.
Root-owned integration can change inspected files during or after report creation. The verifier rejects changed hashes; unchanged dispatch lineage alone does not make stale source evidence valid.
